title: Hot Wallets vs Cold Wallets
summary: A hot wallet is connected to the internet — an app or browser extension — making it convenient for frequent use but more exposed to online threats.
blocks: A hot wallet is connected to the internet — an app or browser extension — making it convenient for frequent use but more exposed to online threats.
A cold wallet is kept offline, often on a dedicated hardware device, which makes it much harder to reach remotely at the cost of some convenience.
Many people use both: a small amount in a hot wallet for everyday use and the bulk in cold storage. The right mix depends on how much convenience and risk you are willing to trade.
